description: End-to-end acceptance test of the containerized API: 520 real HTTP requests (src/drift_traffic.py, balanced 26 tiles x 10 classes per source), then drift_report.py per source. Figures re-derived on 2026-09-13 from the prediction log still present in monitoring.predictions and from the two Evidently JSON summaries copied alongside.

provenance.sql_aggregates: select source, count(*), percentile_cont(0.95) within group (order by latency_ms), avg(confidence), avg(entropy), count(distinct predicted_class), min(ts), max(ts), min(model_version) from monitoring.predictions where source like 'v2:%%' group by source order by source
provenance.sql_class_shares: select source, predicted_class, count(*) from monitoring.predictions where source like 'v2:%%' group by 1,2
provenance.note: The raw prediction log is NOT versioned (Postgres volume); the two Evidently JSONs are. Client-side p95 (~1000-1300 ms) was read live and is not reproducible.
